{{Quote|All-weather equipment fails&hellip;usually in bad weather.|Wilderness Fighter observation.|<ref name="RoE" />}}
The '''Wilderness Fighters''' were a military specialty of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. Trained to fight and survival in a variety of wilderness environments, individual Wilderness Fighters were specialists in a single terrain type. They knew how to use the terrain to their advantage in battle, and how to survive in its depths. Wilderness Fighters included specialists trained in aquatic, arctic, desert, jungle, forest, plains, and mountain survival.

==Organization==
{{Quote|The only terrain you control is the ground you're standing on.|Wilderness Fighter reaction to switch to conventional warfare|<ref name="RoE" />}}
[[File:Wilderness_Fighter_Spec.jpg|thumb|left|A Wilderness Fighter]]
The Wilderness Fighters were a military specialty of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="RASB" /> The 4th Regiment of every SpecForce division was composed entirely of Wilderness Fighters.<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Wilderness Fighters were trained in outdoor combat and survival over a variety of terrains, and were experts in using the terrain to their advantage. All Wilderness Fighters had a grounding in combat and survival in all terrain types, with individual [[Brigade/Legends|brigades]] trained in one specific environment including arctic, aquatic, forest, and mountains.<ref name="RASB" /> Due to the vast number of wilderness areas on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Wilderness Fighter units were constantly in demand, and were spread thin compared to other SpecForce units. When not on missions, Wilderness Fighters generally assisted in guarding bases located within their area of expertise.<ref name="RoE" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Nishr Taskforce]] was classified as a Wilderness Fighter [[Company/Legends|company]] under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fisk Csino]]. Consisting of three Wilderness Fighter [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] and a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] platoon, the taskforce was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nishr]], tasked with engaging the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the world and assisting the local [[Nish]], a [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Nishr Taskforce was organized as a light armor company, equipped with [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] including [[Freerunner/Legends|Freerunners]], [[Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle/Legends|Ultra-Light Assault Vehicles]], and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="RoE" />

==Personnel==
{{Quote|What, you can't eat meat that ain't been through a processing plant, troopy?|Wilderness Fighter|<ref name="RoE" />}}
Wilderness Fighters were generally raised on backwater planets where technology was not prevalent, and the wilds were full of dangerous wildlife. As a result, they learned to live off the land and survive early, and upon joining the Alliance, their skills were put to use by SpecForce. While they were trained to survive in any wilderness environment, they specialized in the environment they were raised in. If operating in a unit with mixed skills, Wilderness Fighters were often breveted to lead trooper when operating in the environment they were most familiar with. Wilderness Fighters were extremely self-reliant, quiet, and disciplined. They had little time for individuals who believe that their use of technology made them superior to others, and many wanted to simply retire to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] at the conclusion of the war. Following [[drop camp]], Wilderness Fighters were trained in combat on a variety of terrain, then specialized in a single terrain type. [[Squad/Legends|Squads]] were organized by terrain type.<ref name="RoE" />

Due the vast array of specializations within the Wilderness Fighters, individual nicknames for soldiers specializing in different terrain types were common. "Nature lovers" was a general terms for the Wilderness Fighters, while aquatic Wilderness Fighters were often referred to as "amphibians," "amphibs," or "fish." Desert Wilderness Fighters were called "sand [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]," arctic Wilderness Fighters had the handle of "[[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]]," and forest Wilderness Fighters were known as "[[Wookiee/Legends|wookiees]]." [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], and other aquatic species made up the bulk of the aquatic Wilderness Fighters,<ref name="RoE" /> and many of the [[Jiivahar]] that joined the Alliance were effective woodland Wilderness Fighters.<ref name="J14">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>

Major Fisk Csino, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was the commanding officer of the Nishr Taskforce. He was veteran Wilderness Fighter officer, having participated in and survived several short campaigns in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="RoE" />

==Skills==
[[File:Wilderness_Fighters-RoE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wilderness Fighters evading Imperial pursuit]]
{{Quote|Terrain can be your best friend&hellip;or your worst nightmare.|Wilderness Fighter to trainee|<ref name="RoE" />}}
Wilderness Fighters were trained to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], as well as [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]].<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> To lessen their dependency on [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]], Wilderness Fighters were also trained in [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and heavy weapons,<ref name="RoE" /> such as blaster artillery and vehicle-mounted blasters.<ref name="RASB2" /> A strong emphasis was placed on survival training, with each Wilderness Fighter capable of survival in almost any terrain, but with additional training in a specific environment, including arctic, aquatic, desert, forest, jungle, plains, or mountains.<ref name="RoE" /> Wilderness Fighters underwent stealth training, and learned to operate a variety of repulsorcraft. They also had expertise in first aid and demolitions.<ref name="RASB" />

==Equipment==
Standard equipment for a Wilderness Fighter were blaster weapons,<ref name="RoE" /> such as a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[survival pack]], and [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]].<ref name="RASB2" /> Wilderness Fighters also favored [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], such as the [[N'Gant-Zarvel]] [[9118 heavy carbine]],<ref name="RoE" /> while the troops of Echo Base used the [[A295 blaster rifle/Legends|A295 blaster rifle]] as a standard weapon.<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Echo Base Trooper Rifle}}</ref> Wilderness Fighters also made heavy use of repulsorcraft, including speeder bikes, [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]], and [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]<ref name="RASB2" />&mdash;the Wilderness Fighters were the only branch to maintain [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] units crew by a single troop type. Aquatic units utilized [[Submarine Transport|Urukaab Submarine Transports]]. [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] [[Thinsuit/Legends|thinsuits]] were liked by Wilderness Fighters for the insulation they provided, and they made use of climbing equipment and [[Graph 18 surface locator]]s. While repulsorcraft was generally employed by Wilderness Fighters, they would also employ creatures suited to the terrain. [[Cracian thumper]]s were ubiquitous throughout the galaxy, and were often used by Wilderness Fighters. Desert Wilderness Fighters liked to ride [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]], aquatic units used [[methnap]]s as mounts, and arctic Wilderness Fighters utilized both tauntauns and [[Tuggle/Legends|tuggles]].<ref name="RoE" />
